For anyone unfamiliar with what the Onion is parodying here - there is an actual movement to replace Andrew Jackson with a woman on the American $20 bill. Apparently they did something similar successfully in other countries.

Why the $20 bill? There isn't actually a good reason. They made up a couple justifications after the fact, but I think it's mainly because the $20 is the most visible denomination - they don't want their hard work to be relegated to something most people won't see, like the $100 bill.
But I love Andrew Jackson. The SJWs can't ruin this. My hatred for them increases every day.

I don't think anyone really gives a shit about protecting Andrew Jackson's currency status - but I also can't think of a well-known woman that would fit in well with the handful of founding fathers, inventors, and presidents that we already have on our currency. The first woman president would be the obvious choice, but apparently there's a rule that the people depicted have to be dead (which is probably why there isn't a call for Obama to have a spot yet - he's pretty damn notable).

Probably the least well-known person is Alexander Hamilton on the $10 bill - but he was the first secretary of the treasury, so it's obvious why he's on there and why he'll never be replaced.

  • Washington
  • Jefferson ($2)
  • Lincoln
  • Hamilton
  • Jackson
  • Grant
  • Franklin

That's an imposing lineup. (coins already have two women that are more widely used than the Kennedy half-dollar, so no realistic complaints there)
Andrew Jackson belongs on the 20 and should never be replaced.
